column_dictionary.image_path: Path to the source scan, relative to Petal_scans/. Read-only source; never modified.
column_dictionary.region_id: 1-indexed region label within this image, largest area first.
column_dictionary.area_cm2: Region area in cm^2, computed from pixel count and the image's own embedded scanner DPI (cm_per_pixel = 2.54 / dpi).
column_dictionary.area_px: Region area in pixels (raw segmentation output, before unit conversion).
column_dictionary.dpi: Scanner resolution read from the PNG's embedded metadata (pHYs chunk). Expected 300 for this project; flagged if missing or different.
column_dictionary.major_axis_length_cm: Longest axis of the best-fit ellipse for the region, in cm — a Feret-diameter-like size descriptor.
column_dictionary.solidity: Region area / convex hull area (0-1). Low solidity flags a ragged/merged/torn segmentation worth a visual check.
column_dictionary.eccentricity: 0 (circle) to 1 (line) — shape descriptor, not used to filter, kept for QC review.
column_dictionary.n_regions_in_image: How many separate regions this method found in the image after cleanup — informs whether an image was single- or multi-petal.
column_dictionary.area_flag: 'OK', or 'IMPLAUSIBLY_LARGE' if area_cm2 exceeds MAX_PLAUSIBLE_PETAL_AREA_CM2 (no real poppy petal is that large — flags a segmentation that likely merged in background/bag/card; never silently dropped, always kept in this table for audit).
column_dictionary.shape_flag: 'OK', or 'LOW_SOLIDITY_CHECK_OVERLAY' if solidity < MIN_SOLIDITY_OK — flags a likely fragmented/incomplete mask for a visual check against the QC overlay before trusting the number.
column_dictionary.is_primary_candidate: True for the largest region per (image_path, method) among those NOT flagged IMPLAUSIBLY_LARGE. This is the region used for single-petal-per-image comparisons; all detected regions are still kept in this table.
column_dictionary.dpi_cm_per_pixel: cm-per-pixel computed from the image's embedded scanner DPI (2.54/dpi). This is the value actually used to compute area_cm2.
column_dictionary.ruler_cm_per_pixel: cm-per-pixel computed independently from the physical ruler's own tick spacing in this image (see estimate_scale_from_ruler). None if no confidently periodic tick pattern was found. NOT used to compute area_cm2 — reported as a cross-check on dpi_cm_per_pixel.
column_dictionary.ruler_tick_period_px: Detected pixel spacing between adjacent 1mm ruler ticks, via autocorrelation. None if ruler not detected.
column_dictionary.ruler_confidence: Normalized autocorrelation peak height (0-1) for the detected tick period — higher means more confidently periodic (i.e. more likely a real ruler, not a coincidental texture). None if ruler not detected.
column_dictionary.ruler_strip_orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal' — which axis the detected ruler's tick marks run along in this image. None if ruler not detected.
column_dictionary.ruler_strip_coord: Pixel coordinate (column if vertical, row if horizontal) where the detected ruler strip starts — drawn as a yellow band on the QC overlay for visual audit. None if ruler not detected.
column_dictionary.scale_pct_diff: 100 * (ruler_cm_per_pixel - dpi_cm_per_pixel) / dpi_cm_per_pixel — how far the ruler-based estimate differs from the DPI-based one. None if ruler not detected.
column_dictionary.scale_flag: 'OK' (agree within SCALE_MISMATCH_PCT_TOLERANCE), 'SCALE_MISMATCH' (disagree beyond tolerance — investigate before trusting area_cm2), or 'RULER_NOT_DETECTED'.
column_dictionary.batch: 'validation_2025_03_26' (distribution-level hand-measurement check, identity not confirmed) or 'resolved' (identity confirmed via petal_area_master.csv, results written back to that file per plant).
column_dictionary.centroid_row: Region centroid row (y, pixels) in the RAW (as-scanned) image, before any orientation correction.
column_dictionary.centroid_col: Region centroid column (x, pixels) in the RAW image, before any orientation correction.
column_dictionary.image_height_px: Raw image height in pixels (as scanned, before any orientation correction) — needed to convert centroid_row to an orientation-corrected quadrant.
column_dictionary.image_width_px: Raw image width in pixels, as above.
column_dictionary.orientation_upright: True if the scan is right-side-up (detected from the handwritten date/population label block's vertical position — every scan reviewed in this project places that label in the upper portion when upright), False if rotated 180 degrees, None if no text block was confidently found. Used by scripts/09_assign_petal_numbers.py to map detected regions to the correct physical quadrant.
column_dictionary.orientation_confidence: Fraction of image area occupied by the detected label-text block used for the orientation call. Not a statistical confidence — a bigger, clearer block is generally more trustworthy, but always spot-check via the QC overlay before trusting an automated call on this.
column_dictionary.orientation_note: Human-readable detail behind the orientation_upright call (label block's row position vs. image height).
